title: Practice: clear completed leaves tasks behind
task: In my to-do app, when I tick several tasks as done and press 'Clear completed', some of the finished tasks are still on the screen. Please fix it.

good_edit.text: Fix clear_completed in todo.py by changing the list in place: self.items[:] = [item for item in self.items if not item['done']]. Do not assign a new list to self.items, because the screen keeps a reference to it.

checks.test_two_done_in_a_row: Clear completed removes two finished tasks that are next to each other.
checks.test_screen_sees_the_change: The screen shows the cleared list straight away, without reloading.
checks.test_nothing_done: Clear completed with nothing finished changes nothing.
